empirical_windows_behavior: Handles USB Request Blocks (URBs): GET_DESCRIPTOR_FROM_DEVICE, SELECT_CONFIGURATION, VENDOR/CLASS control requests, and BULK/INTERRUPT transfers.
Translates Windows URBs to macOS IOKit IOUSBDevRequest or libusb control/transfer submissions.
macos_backend_strategy: Submit control and data transfers via macOS IOUSBDeviceInterface / DeviceRequest or libusb-1.0.

sources: Microsoft Learn USB Request Block (URB) specification
